newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-KONE JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-KONE JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 29 million markka median
forecast for Finnish elevator maker Kone Oy's January-April
profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (FIM)
Median 29 1.6
Lowest 12 0.7
Highest 48 2.6
(Profit forecasts by 12 analysts, EPS by eight analysts).
Kone's results are due on June 6 at 1300/1000 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Kone posted a profit of 17 million
markka.
In February, Kone said it expected group 1997 earnings to be
only somewhat better than last year.
The median of nine analysts' forecasts for Kone's full-year
1997 profit before extras and tax was 178 million markka (mean
179 million) in a 149-220 million markka range. In 1996, Kone's
profit was 124 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities,
Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM
Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities
and Postipankki.
